metadata.title: Monochromatic Group Portrait with Perimeter Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio photograph of four men in dark, patterned streetwear standing against a stark white background, framed by a thin black line and repetitive perimeter typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Stark contrast between black clothing and pure white negative space
Hierarchical depth created by varying the scale and vertical positioning of the four subjects
Repetitive typographic border acting as a structural frame for the central image
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no shadows or floor line
Repetitive text running horizontally across the top and vertically down the right edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a staggered formation; the central figure is largest and highest, while flanking figures are smaller and lower, creating a triangular peak.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central, tallest figure wearing a highly patterned shirt acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central figure, moves to the flanking members, and then follows the repetitive text border around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the group, pushing them into sharp relief.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Grey (Subtle highlights on clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between pure white and deep black.

letterConstructionRules: Varying case styles (all-caps, lowercase, title case) repeated in sequence
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in multiple case variations to create rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic grotesque look with high legibility and neutral character.
Provides a slightly more industrial, 90s urban feel.
Clean, mathematical spacing suitable for repetitive patterns.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white studio photograph of four men in 90s streetwear. The central man is tallest, wearing a black shirt with white ornate filigree patterns. The others wear dark jackets and boots. All stand against a seamless, pure white background with no visible floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin black rectangular frame inside the canvas edges. Outside this frame, place a repeating string of text in a bold sans-serif font. The text should alternate between all-caps, lowercase, and title case. Run the text horizontally across the top and vertically down the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the text strictly black on white?
Does the text repeat in different case styles?
Is there a thin black line separating the text from the image?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
Specific sans-serif typeface used for the border
Thickness of the internal border line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

avoid: Soft edges or gradients in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for any color artifacts in the grayscale image.
Ensure the vertical text is rotated exactly 90 degrees.
Verify the central figure is the tallest in the composition.
Confirm the border line is perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast group portrait in black and white, place it against a void-white background, and frame it with a repetitive typographic border using a bold sans-serif font in alternating cases.
